cases.purpose: Show that each history -s command replaces its own saved history line with its arguments, and that an earlier argument remains.
cases.comparison: Run history -c, then each history -s, as its own command. The listing must contain the argument and must not contain that history -s command as its own line.
cases.oracle: Bash history -s removes the last history entry before adding its arguments. In one compound command, history -c leaves the list empty and the following history -s does not add.
